notes:
What's new in 0.1.99:
- Audiobooks: closing the player keeps your place, and a book that showed "[object Object]" is read again on the next scan (progress and bookmarks kept).
- Library scans skip hidden files such as Mac "._" copies, .DS_Store and Thumbs.db.
- Sidebar Movies and TV Shows counts update as soon as you add or remove an extra folder; a changed Photos folder list no longer shows the old albums.
- Live TV: a parental check that runs into an error is handled the same way everywhere (allowed, as before, and noted in the log). A restricted profile is still blocked.
- Converter: a computer whose ffmpeg has libx264 but not OpenH264 can now convert videos. Windows with the built-in ffmpeg is unchanged.
- Smaller fixes: version heading, messages follow a language switch, clearer Picture frame, Kitchen announcements and tuner hints.
- Not yet checked: none of this has been tried on the installed app on a real PC. Automated tests and reviews only.
- Release source commit c43f13d27.
- Published: Oct 21, 2026, 3:46 PM Eastern.
